pa_server.label: PulseAudio server address
pa_server.description: PulseAudio server socket or TCP address (e.g. unix:/run/audio/pulse.sock). Leave empty to use the PULSE_SERVER environment variable or the default socket path.

source_name.label: PulseAudio source name
source_name.description: Name of a specific PulseAudio source to expose (e.g. alsa_input.pci-0000_00_1b.0.analog-stereo). Leave empty to auto-discover all hardware input sources.

display_name.label: Display name
display_name.description: Friendly name shown in the Music Assistant UI. Overrides the PulseAudio source description when set.

sample_rate.label: Sample rate (Hz)
sample_rate.description: Capture sample rate in Hz. Match the native rate of your audio interface for best quality (e.g. 44100 for CD, 48000 for HDMI/S/PDIF, 96000 for high-res).

bit_depth.label: Bit depth
bit_depth.description: Capture bit depth. 16-bit is compatible with all players; use 24-bit for high-resolution sources.

channels.label: Channels
channels.description: Number of audio channels to capture.

pa_not_available: PulseAudio is not available or the server is unreachable. Check the PULSE_SERVER address and ensure PulseAudio is running.
